lines.zh: 我拍着两片薄翼，在水里飘。
lines.en: I beat my two thin wings and drift through the water.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我的身体就跟着偏。
lines.en: The current shifts and my body tilts with it.

lines.zh: 冰沟的水很冷，我反而游得轻快。
lines.en: Trench water is cold, and I swim lighter in it.

lines.zh: 我转弯不用力，身体自己就弯了。
lines.en: I turn without effort; my body bends on its own.

lines.zh: 两翼一合，我往上飘了一截。
lines.en: My wings close and I float up a little.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的暗处滑到另一处暗处。
lines.en: I glide from one dark part of the trench to another.

lines.zh: 水压这么大，我却轻得像气泡。
lines.en: The pressure is heavy, yet I am light as a bubble.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟壁游，那里水稳一些。
lines.en: I swim along the trench wall where water is calmer.

lines.zh: 翼尖碰到海雪，散成一小片白。
lines.en: My wingtip hits marine snow and it scatters white.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼经过，我立刻往下沉。
lines.en: A large fish passes and I sink at once.

lines.zh: 我在冷流里翻了个身，肚皮朝上。
lines.en: I roll in the cold current, belly upward.

lines.zh: 越深越静，我的翼声显得很响。
lines.en: Deeper it is quieter, so my wings sound loud.

lines.zh: 身体太软，撞到礁石就变形。
lines.en: I am so soft that a reef knocks me out of shape.

lines.zh: 我游过整条海沟，只用了一点点力。
lines.en: I crossed the whole trench on almost no effort.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟壁往上，越往上越冷。
lines.en: I climb the trench wall, colder with every metre.

lines.zh: 两翼扇得太快，我撞上了海雪。
lines.en: My wings beat too fast and I blunder into marine snow.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，身体还在轻轻晃。
lines.en: I stop in the water and my body keeps swaying.

lines.zh: 一道冷流推来，我顺着它滑下去。
lines.en: A cold current comes; I ride it down.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，翼还在一开一合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, wings still opening and closing.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，我也在慢慢上下浮。
lines.en: Doing nothing, I still drift slowly up and down.

lines.zh: 冷水从翼间穿过，很舒服。
lines.en: Cold water passes between my wings, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 我缩起翼，把自己团成一小粒。
lines.en: I fold my wings and ball up into a small speck.

lines.zh: 海雪落在我身上，我也不拂。
lines.en: Marine snow settles on me and I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 沟底很黑，我的身体几乎透明。
lines.en: The trench floor is dark; my body is nearly clear.

lines.zh: 我停在一股冷流里，随它晃。
lines.en: I rest in a cold current and sway with it.

lines.zh: 偶尔扇一下翼，只是为了不掉下去。
lines.en: Now and then I flap, only to keep from sinking.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，安静得听不见声。
lines.en: A body this small makes no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我张着口，等水流带东西过来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let the water bring things.

lines.zh: 头顶的水面远得像另一个世界。
lines.en: The surface above feels like another world.

lines.zh: 我贴在沟壁的凹处，藏住自己。
lines.en: I tuck into a hollow of the trench wall.

lines.zh: 冷得发木，我反而更清醒。
lines.en: The cold numbs me, and I am more awake.

lines.zh: 一动不动时，我像水里的一粒冰。
lines.en: Motionless, I look like a grain of ice in water.

lines.zh: 你身上的灯，比海沟里任何东西都亮。
lines.en: Your lamp is brighter than anything in this trench.

lines.zh: 你游得真吵，气泡一串串往上跑。
lines.en: You swim loudly, bubbles streaming upward.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，你别靠太近。
lines.en: I have one point of life; do not come too close.

lines.zh: 你的护目镜后面，有双眼睛在找我。
lines.en: Behind your goggles, eyes are searching for me.

lines.zh: 我悬在你面前，翼慢慢扇着。
lines.en: I hover before you, wings beating slowly.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，水流先到了。
lines.en: You reach out, and the water arrives before your hand.

lines.zh: 冰海沟里，我只有指甲那么大。
lines.en: In the frozen trench, I'm no bigger than a fingernail.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在沟壁间来回撞。
lines.en: Your breathing bounces back and forth off the walls.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转了一圈，确认你不是鱼。
lines.en: I circle you once to be sure you are not a fish.

lines.zh: 你停住不动，我才敢靠近一点。
lines.en: You hold still, and only then do I come closer.

lines.zh: 只一下，我就快撑不住了。
lines.en: One hit and I am nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我的身体破了一角，水灌进来。
lines.en: A corner of me tears and water seeps in.

lines.zh: 好疼，我缩成很小的一团。
lines.en: It hurts; I curl into a tiny ball.

lines.zh: 我飘不动了，只能随水转。
lines.en: I cannot swim, only tumble with the water.

lines.zh: 这一下几乎要了我的命。
lines.en: That blow nearly took my life.

lines.zh: 我的翼裂了，扇起来漏风。
lines.en: My wing is split and beats with a leak.

lines.zh: 疼得我几乎化在水里。
lines.en: It hurts so much I nearly dissolve into the water.

lines.zh: 我翻过来，半天没正过来。
lines.en: I flip over and cannot right myself for a while.

lines.zh: 一点生命，禁不起第二下。
lines.en: One point of life will not survive a second blow.

lines.zh: 我往暗处躲，可速度太慢。
lines.en: I flee toward the dark, but I am too slow.

lines.zh: 你指间漏下的碎屑，够我吃很久。
lines.en: The crumbs slipping from your fingers would feed me long.

lines.zh: 那点白色的小东西，是海雪吗？
lines.en: That small white thing, is it marine snow?

lines.zh: 水流把味道送过来，我跟着转。
lines.en: The current carries a taste and I turn after it.

lines.zh: 我太轻了，一点香味就拉得动我。
lines.en: I am so light that a faint scent pulls me along.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在飘，我盯住了。
lines.en: What you hold is drifting, and I have fixed on it.

lines.zh: 别捏碎，碎了就沉下去了。
lines.en: Do not crush it; broken pieces just sink away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，翼几乎不敢动。
lines.en: I approach slowly, my wings barely daring to move.

lines.zh: 这种细小的食物，我一天也吃不完。
lines.en: Food this fine would last me a whole day.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，水流太急了。
lines.en: I open my mouth to try, but the current is too quick.

lines.zh: 你退开些，我才有胆量过来。
lines.en: Move back a little so I dare to come over.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，我差点散开。
lines.en: You touched me and I nearly came apart.

lines.zh: 我被水推得翻了个身，翼还在扇。
lines.en: The push rolled me over; my wings keep beating.

lines.zh: 别用手指弹我，我只有一点生命。
lines.en: Do not flick me; I have only one point of life.

lines.zh: 撞上你的护腕，我黏了一下才滑开。
lines.en: I hit your bracer and stuck before sliding off.

lines.zh: 我软得很，撞哪儿都留不下痕。
lines.en: I am so soft that hitting anything leaves no mark.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推出去好远。
lines.en: That knock sent me drifting far away.

lines.zh: 水流乱了，我分不清上下。
lines.en: The water churns and I cannot tell up from down.

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅起的沙，把我埋了半截。
lines.en: Sand from your boots half buries me.

lines.zh: 我不生气，只是需要缓一缓。
lines.en: I am not angry, I just need a moment.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，我的翼有一边不太听使唤。
lines.en: After the bump, one of my wings will not obey.

lines.zh: 另一只海天使贴过来，翼碰着翼。
lines.en: Another sea angel drifts near, wing against wing.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，像两片薄冰。
lines.en: We hang side by side like two thin flakes of ice.

lines.zh: 它比我更透明，几乎看不见。
lines.en: It is clearer than I am, almost invisible.

lines.zh: 冷流把我们推到一起，又分开。
lines.en: The cold current pushes us together, then apart.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一个圈慢慢转。
lines.en: We circle each other slowly, round and round.

lines.zh: 它的翼拍得比我快，我跟不上。
lines.en: Its wings beat faster than mine and I fall behind.

lines.zh: 两只一起浮，海雪都显得少了。
lines.en: Two of us drifting make the marine snow seem sparse.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰它，它就朝我这边偏。
lines.en: I touch it and it tilts toward me.

lines.zh: 这条海沟够大，够我们两个待着。
lines.en: This trench is big enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 等小的孵出来，水里会多一层白点。
lines.en: When the small ones hatch, the water gains a layer of white specks.

lines.zh: 那粒东西沉下来了，我去捡。
lines.en: That speck has sunk, so I go and get it.

lines.zh: 太沉了，我用翼推着走。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I push it with my wings.

lines.zh: 我捡东西从不带回家，因为没有家。
lines.en: I never carry things home, since I have no home.

lines.zh: 一小片碎壳，能当遮挡吗？
lines.en: A small shell chip, could it serve as cover?

lines.zh: 我用身体压住它，免得被冲走。
lines.en: I press my body on it so the current cannot take it.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西？我先替它拿着。
lines.en: Someone dropped this; I will hold it for now.

lines.zh: 太重了，我推了两下就放弃。
lines.en: Too heavy; I push twice and give up.

lines.zh: 这粒海雪刚好落在我的翼上。
lines.en: This bit of marine snow landed right on my wing.

lines.zh: 我抱着它慢慢往下沉。
lines.en: I hold it and sink slowly downward.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西，我通常转手就丢。
lines.en: What I pick up, I usually lose again.

lines.zh: 有影子掠过，我停住翼。
lines.en: A shadow sweeps past and I stop my wings.

lines.zh: 那东西比我大太多，我盯住它。
lines.en: It is far bigger than I am, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我转向动的那一边。
lines.en: I turn toward the side that moved.

lines.zh: 是不是吃的，先看清再说。
lines.en: Whether it is food, I must see it clearly first.

lines.zh: 我往沟壁那边挪，离它远点。
lines.en: I edge toward the trench wall, away from it.

lines.zh: 它一动，我全身都绷紧了。
lines.en: It moves, and my whole body goes taut.

lines.zh: 我锁定那片晃动的暗影。
lines.en: I lock onto that wavering dark shape.

lines.zh: 太小了，也许只是海雪在飘。
lines.en: It is so small; perhaps it is only marine snow.

lines.zh: 我看清了，是条小鱼，不是吃的。
lines.en: Now I see: a small fish, and not food.

lines.zh: 我记住了这个方向，先避开。
lines.en: I mark this direction and keep away for now.

lines.zh: 我一直看它，翼都忘了扇。
lines.en: I keep watching it and forget to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 它游远了，我的目光还跟着。
lines.en: It swims away and my gaze still follows.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，身体开始下沉。
lines.en: I stare so long that I begin to sink.

lines.zh: 它绕到礁石后面，我等着。
lines.en: It slips behind the reef and I wait.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比身体更用力。
lines.en: My eyes are working harder than my body.

lines.zh: 那影子一闪，我又找到了它。
lines.en: The shadow flickers and I find it again.

lines.zh: 它停下来，我也停在半空。
lines.en: It halts, and I halt in open water.

lines.zh: 我这么小，看着它也没有什么用。
lines.en: Small as I am, watching it does little good.

lines.zh: 冷流推我偏了，我还是盯着。
lines.en: The cold current pushes me off, and I keep staring.

lines.zh: 它没回头，我却不敢动。
lines.en: It does not look back, and I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，它几乎没有感觉。
lines.en: I ram it, and it barely notices.

lines.zh: 我的力气，连水都推不开。
lines.en: I am not strong enough to push water aside.

lines.zh: 这一下更像碰了一下。
lines.en: This blow is more like a touch.

lines.zh: 我用翼拍它，翼先弯了。
lines.en: I slap it with a wing, and the wing bends first.

lines.zh: 它退开，大概是被我烦到了。
lines.en: It backs off, probably just annoyed by me.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，什么也没咬到。
lines.en: I bite once and catch nothing at all.

lines.zh: 一点生命换一点疼，不划算。
lines.en: One point of life for a little pain is a poor trade.

lines.zh: 我冲上去，然后被水流带走。
lines.en: I charge in, then get carried off by the current.

lines.zh: 这一击很轻，但我尽力了。
lines.en: The hit was light, but I did my best.

lines.zh: 打完之后，我自己先飘开了。
lines.en: After the strike, I am the one drifting away.

lines.zh: 我在冰封海沟的冷水里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the cold of a frozen trench.

lines.zh: 一出现，我就开始扇翼。
lines.en: The moment I appear, I start beating my wings.

lines.zh: 旁边还有一只，和我一样透明。
lines.en: Another one is nearby, as transparent as I am.

lines.zh: 这里冷得发蓝，我却觉得刚好。
lines.en: It is blue with cold here, and I find it right.

lines.zh: 我从海雪里浮出来，轻得没有声。
lines.en: I rise out of the marine snow, silent and light.

lines.zh: 水温很低，我的身体缩了一下。
lines.en: The water is very cold and my body flinches.

lines.zh: 头一件事，是找一股稳的冷流。
lines.en: First, I look for a steady cold current.

lines.zh: 沟壁很高，我抬头也看不到顶。
lines.en: The trench walls are tall; I cannot see the top.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，所以格外小心。
lines.en: I have one point of life, so I am very careful.

lines.zh: 我在这条温带海沟里开始游动。
lines.en: I begin swimming in this temperate trench.

lines.zh: 火在水里只剩一声嘶。
lines.en: Underwater, fire is only a hiss.

lines.zh: 我从水柱里掉下去，翼折了。
lines.en: I dropped through the water column and my wing folded.

lines.zh: 我住在水里，可也会被闷死。
lines.en: I live in water, and still I can drown.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得像一片碎纸。
lines.en: The blast throws me like a scrap of paper.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过来，从我身体中间过。
lines.en: Something came through and passed right through me.

lines.zh: 那股力量捏住我，我连挣扎都轻。
lines.en: That force grips me, and even my struggle is faint.

lines.zh: 水里没有海雪，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: No marine snow in the water, and I grow faint.

lines.zh: 白光透进海沟，我全身一颤。
lines.en: White light reaches the trench and I shudder.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的翼扇不动。
lines.en: Without water, my wings beat at nothing.
